messages:
Eli: Quick idea 1: afterwork karaoke + happy hour this Wednesday? Short set at 6:30, then drinks after. Who's in? :microphone: :tropical_drink:
Sasha: In! Love karaoke. Can we do a quieter spot first (basement room) then migrate to bar?
Morgan: I can make it but need to leave by 9:30. Fine with basement room first.
Rami: Count me in. Can bring a small portable speaker if the venue is low on gear.
Tori: Might be late (team dinner), but I'll try to join for drinks. RSVP maybe?
Eli: Good call. I'll ping the venue about a small private space. Doing a quick poll for time: 6:00 start vs 6:30.
EventBot: Poll created: "Start at 6:00 vs 6:30" Poll open for 24h.
Sasha: 6:30 please 1, easier for commuters.
Rami: 6:30 for me too.
Morgan: 6:00 would be better but I can do 6:30.
EventBot: Poll results: 6:30 18 votes, 6:00 6 votes. Outcome: Start at 6:30pm. Venue hold requested: The Alley Backroom (link: https://thealley.example).
Eli: Booked the backroom for 10 people at 6:30. If anyone wants to sing, add your song picks to the thread. I'll bring a small prize (gift card) for crowd favorite.
Sasha: Adding song: "Mr. Brightside"
Rami: I'll do a guilty-pleasure duet 1 setlist TBD.
Tori: I'll try to make it for drinks, may join for a song if timing works.
Morgan: Thanks for booking Eli. See y'all Wednesday :)
Eli: Final note: if anyone needs a ride, DM me. I'll post a reminder Wednesday morning. Closing thread. :sparkles:
